recipes.title: Khaman / Dhokla
steps: Take big bowl and pass Gram Flour from sieve.
Add Salt, Sugar and Citric Acid, mix well.
Then add water small amount at a time and mix with whisk to avoid lumps
you will get a thick batter.
Now get the steamer ready and grease your pan
Now at end add baking soda + small amount of water and mix briskly
You will see batter double up due to bubbles and reaction between acid and base.
Pour it in steaming pan and cook it for 20 mins
Once cooked, take it out of pan and let it cool
Make your tadka and add 1 cup water to it. Heat it and pour on top of khaman and Enjoy
